title: v5.1.18 — Game Fixes & Countdown
message: Baccarat now shows cards on the very first deal instead of staying blank. Bomb Defuser hint cost now scales smoothly with your bet (10 bet → 5 chips, 250 bet → 125 chips) and the button shows the price. Skip All on achievement toasts now animates every pending toast out together. New release-countdown banner: if release.json is present in the repo, a live timer shows at the top until release, then a save-and-refresh popup fires at zero.
